subject: Decision-owner mapping & intro request — Orbit AI
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@orbitai.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@orbitai.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Decision-owner mapping & intro request — Orbit AI

Karen / Tom — thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: product-facing LLM features (assistants + summarization) across customer dashboards.
- Success metrics: sub-200ms median generation for 512 tokens, 3x reduction in per-request unit cost vs current hosts, and predictable throughput for peak business hours.
- Compliance asks: SOC2 evidence and network isolation options for enterprise customers referenced.
- Timeline: internal procurement/budget discussions expected in Q4; preferred pilot before EOY.

Stakeholder map (as we heard it):
- Product/PO sponsor: Tom Hargreaves (VP Product) — final decision authority on product fit and roadmap prioritization.
- Procurement/billing owner: procurement@orbitai.com — handles T&Cs and PO process.
- Technical evaluation: you mentioned an internal engineering reviewer (please share name if different).

What we need from you to move to an intro and M.A.P.:
1) Confirm the economic buyer / budget owner (is Tom the right owner or should we loop in Finance?)
2) Share any procurement checklist or vendor questionnaire we should pre-fill (we can supply SOC2 link and an implementation plan).
3) A 30–45 min slot for a short intro between Tom + procurement + our team next week (we can be flexible).

Attached: OrbitAI-MutualActionPlan.xlsx (draft) — I put tentative milestones and a pilot outline.

If Tom is the budget owner, happy to do a short pricing framing doc prior to the intro so he has context. Proposed slots: Mon 7/20 10:00–10:45 PT, Tue 7/21 11:00–11:45 PT, Wed 7/22 14:00–14:45 PT.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
Redwood Inference — Inference that fits your product

(attachment: OrbitAI-MutualActionPlan.xlsx)

From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@orbitai.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision-owner mapping & intro request — Orbit AI

Thanks Rafael — good summary, appreciated. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed economic/budget owner: Tom Hargreaves (VP Product) will own the capital spend for the pilot. He'll want to see estimated unit economics and a short ROI slide.
- Procurement contact: procurement@orbitai.com is the right mailbox; they will expect a completed vendor questionnaire and our standard contract terms.
- Timeline: we are aiming to lock pilot budget in the first two weeks of October (Q4). Production timelines likely push into Q1 depending on pilot results.

I've attached our internal RFP overview (OrbitAI-RFP-Overview.pdf) — it includes procurement checklist and required compliance artifacts. Can you send the SOC2 link and a short pricing worksheet? Tom would also like a one-page comparison vs our current host (latency/cost).

Let's do the intro with Tom and procurement — Tue 7/21 11:00 PT works for us. Please include your SE and someone who can speak to deployment options (VPC/on-prem).

Best,
Karen Liu
Head of Platform Partnerships, Orbit AI
karen.liu@orbitai.com
(attachment: OrbitAI-RFP-Overview.pdf)

Thanks Karen — great, locking Tue 7/21 11:00 PT on our end. Looping in Neha (SE) and Marissa (AM) so they can prep the technical runbook and pricing frame. 

Neha/Marissa — fyi attached is the OrbitAI RFP overview Karen shared. Immediate asks from Orbit that we should prepare before Tue: 
- SOC2 report (we can share our report + controls matrix).
- Short pricing worksheet with pilot pricing, expected per-token unit rates, and an example cost breakdown for 100k tokens/day.
- Short one-pager comparing Redwood latency profiles vs a managed-host competitor (focus on median/95th pct for 512-token sequences).

Karen/Tom/procurement: we've attached a draft pricing worksheet (Redwood-Initial-Pricing-worksheet.xlsx) and a link to our SOC2 report here: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-report

Prep notes for Tue 7/21 meeting: 30–40 minute agenda — 1) brief product fit + performance baseline (Neha), 2) procurement checklist & legal next steps (Marissa), 3) pilot scope & success criteria (Rafael).

If procurement has a preferred NDA/PO template prior to the meeting, please share and we'll have legal review.

Thanks — Rafael

(attachments: Redwood-Initial-Pricing-worksheet.xlsx)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Karen Liu <karen.liu@orbitai.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@orbitai.com>, procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision-owner mapping & intro request — Orbit AI

Confirmed — I'll own the 15–20 minute performance baseline + tech summary for Tue. A couple quick asks to make that efficient: 

1) Can Orbit share the expected max sequence length and typical prompt/response distribution for the pilot (avg tokens in / out)? That will let me pick the right model variant and batching profile.
2) Any specific security controls procurement needs beyond SOC2 (e.g., customer-managed keys, audit log retention)?

Draft tech evaluation checklist (I'll bring this to the meeting):
- Req1: median latency target at 512 tokens (we will supply benchmarking numbers).
- Req2: throughput target (requests/sec) and peak concurrency.
- Req3: data residency/VPC peering requirement.
- Req4: allowed model families and quantization restrictions.

I'll prepare a short slide with examples and a rough cost projection for the pilot. See you Tue 7/21 11:00 PT.

Thanks — Neha
